semantics.identity_rule: Each executable command has an explicit stable command identity.
semantics.operation_rule: Command maps to one exact canonical operation or declared command execution semantics.
semantics.execution_rule: Concrete command invocation creates a separate request/execution identity.
semantics.alias_rule: Aliases are explicit and never create duplicate command semantics.
semantics.authority_rule: Command registration does not authorize caller.

invariants.rule: Command, Routine, Trigger, Schedule, Tool and model definitions remain separate from invocations, requests, executions and results; definitions never create effects merely by existing.
Automated work still resolves exact operation/target/context and must cross validation, authorization and dispatcher boundaries before any effect occurs.

hard_gates.condition: command path reused as execution identity

references.purpose: Concrete command nodes live under exact families.
